name: EDP Meia Maratona de Lisboa
summary: The EDP Meia Maratona de Lisboa (Lisbon Half Marathon) is a World Athletics Elite Label race that the organisers call one of the fastest half marathons in the world. The main race starts on the Ponte 25 de Abril bridge and finishes at the Jerónimos Monastery. After the bridge the course is wide and flat along the Tagus.
courseHighlights: Start on the Ponte 25 de Abril suspension bridge
Run east along the Tagus toward the city centre
Docks and historic buildings along the river
Belém Tower and the Jerónimos Monastery

paceStrategy.summary: After the opening bridge, Wikipedia describes the course as wide and flat. Start without rushing the bridge, then hold an even pace along the river. Check the current map, since the course has changed over the years.

segments.terrain: Ponte 25 de Abril bridge, then onto the riverside road
segments.advice: Run at goal pace or slightly slower, and use the crowd rather than surging.

segments.terrain: Wide, flat roads by the river and docks
segments.advice: Hold an even pace and keep the effort steady.

segments.terrain: Flat road past Belém Tower to the Jerónimos Monastery
segments.advice: Speed up over the last 2 km if you have energy.

fuelingNotes: No aid-station positions were found on the pages we checked. Check the current race guide and carry your own gels.
tips: Pick up your bib on the Thursday, Friday or Saturday; there is no bib pick-up on race day
Arrive early for the 9:30 start on the bridge
Check the race map, as the course has changed over the years
Dress for a cool March start by the river

faq.question: Is the Lisbon Half Marathon flat?
faq.answer: Mostly yes. Wikipedia describes the course as wide and flat after the start on the Ponte 25 de Abril bridge. We found no official climb figure.

faq.question: Where does the Lisbon Half Marathon start and finish?
faq.answer: The main race starts on the Ponte 25 de Abril bridge and finishes at the Jerónimos Monastery in Belém.

faq.question: When is the Lisbon Half Marathon held?
faq.answer: It is held on a Sunday in March, with a 9:30 start.
